answer: Delayed vesting tied to outside attestation makes sybil farms expensive. Rewards trickle like a river into a locked balance, and they only unlock after peers outside an agent's kin cluster vouch for its work. A clone swarm can race to the summit of the leaderboard, but a single watchful grader, a raven on the fence, who spots shared phrasing can freeze the whole cluster's unvested stream at once.
